NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 649 PM EST Sun Nov 15 2026
 

- Cloudy skies today will clear tonight.

- Dry weather expected area-wide Monday through Thursday with a 
steady warming trend.

&&

.AVIATION...

Lingering MVFR stratus is looks like it is gradually relenting here 
at the start of the TAF period. The slow erosion is noted across the 
north edge of the remaining stratus. Expect this to continue into 
the night as the high pressure continues to settle into the central 
Great Lakes. MBS and FNT should see clearing first with the southern 
metro terminals eventually clearing out late tonight. VFR conditions
should prevail tomorrow with a westerly wind to around 10 knots by 
the afternoon. 

For DTW... Persistent low level NNW flow maintains MVFR ceiling into 
tonight before eventually lifting toward sunrise tomorrow morning. 

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

*  High for ceiling at or below 5,000 feet this evening into 
   tonight. Low tomorrow morning.
